notes: Found the actual cause, from the new event log: the preview player was reaching 'ready' twice but never rendering a frame. The hidden video surface was being set to GONE instead of INVISIBLE - a GONE view is skipped by Android's layout system entirely, so it never got a real surface for the decoder to draw into, even though the player itself was ready to play. It now stays INVISIBLE (still properly laid out, just not drawn) until the first real frame arrives, which should let actual video finally render.
